# WanderUSVI

> US Virgin Islands tour discovery platform. Hundreds of bookable tours across St. Thomas, St. John, and St. Croix.

WanderUSVI helps travelers find and book authentic US Virgin Islands experiences from local operators. We aggregate tours from across the three main US Virgin Islands, making it easy to discover snorkeling, sailing and catamaran trips, kayaking, hiking, fishing, and more. Booking goes direct to the operator — no middleman markup.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://wanderusvi.com/): Search and browse US Virgin Islands tours
- [All Tours](https://wanderusvi.com/tours.html): Complete tour directory with filters
- [St. Thomas Guide](https://wanderusvi.com/st-thomas.html): St. Thomas tours, beaches and things to do
- [St. John Guide](https://wanderusvi.com/st-john.html): St. John tours, Virgin Islands National Park
- [St. Croix Guide](https://wanderusvi.com/st-croix.html): St. Croix tours, Christiansted and Frederiksted

## Activity Guides

- [Snorkeling](https://wanderusvi.com/snorkeling.html): Reef and boat snorkel trips; spots include Trunk Bay, Buck Island Reef National Monument, Honeymoon Bay
- [Kayaking](https://wanderusvi.com/kayak.html): Sea kayak and kayak-snorkel combos; Hurricane Hole mangroves, Lameshur Bay
- [Fishing](https://wanderusvi.com/fishing.html): Offshore and inshore charters; the North Drop off St. Thomas, Lang Bank off St. Croix
- [Jet Skis](https://wanderusvi.com/jet-ski.html): Rentals and guided rides on St. Thomas
- [Ziplines](https://wanderusvi.com/zipline.html): One operator, Tree Limin' Extreme on St. Thomas
- [Private Charters](https://wanderusvi.com/private-charters-usvi.html): Full-day and overnight boat charters
- [BVI Day Trip](https://wanderusvi.com/bvi-day-trip-from-usvi.html): Day sails from the USVI to the British Virgin Islands

## Quick Facts

- Hundreds of bookable tours from local operators
- 3 US Virgin Islands covered: St. Thomas, St. John, St. Croix
- Tours include: snorkeling, boat tours, sailing and catamaran trips, private charters, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, hiking, scuba, parasailing, fishing, food tours, and ATV/UTV
- Booking links go directly to tour operators via FareHarbor
- Prices vary widely by activity, from shared half-day trips to whole-boat private charters
